note: St. Croix County park: 700 wooded acres around 78-acre Glen Lake near Glenwood City. Peninsula Campground's wooded loops fill a peninsula in the lake, with the two camper cabins at its tip; Vista Prairie is an open loop on the prairie 0.9 km north, beside the Whispering Oaks extended-stay campground; Picnic Point takes tents and truck campers only. Swim beach, non-motorized boat landing, fishing pier, disc golf; adjacent public golf course. --Claude
